theorems.name: Submission.ae_of_forall_relCompactOpen_null_exceptional
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (P : Euclidean N → Prop), IsOpen U → μ Uᶜ = 0 → (∀ W : Set (Euclidean N), IsRelCompactOpenIn W U → ∃ E : Set (Euclidean N), μ E = 0 ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, x ∉ E → P x) → ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, P x
